the_business.what_it_does: Manufactures precision machined crankshafts and undercarriage chassis components for automotive, defense, and heavy industries.

the_growth_engine: New 52,000 MT precision machining facility coming online
Direct Tier-1 supplier empanelment across North America & Europe

the_big_change.summary: Transformation from a low-margin rough forging supplier into a high-margin finished precision component manufacturer.

hard_evidence: Successful sample batch validation with European Tier-1 OEMs

why_we_believe_it: Premise 1: Factory construction is physically complete and initial sample batches passed OEM testing.
Premise 2: Forward supply agreements already lock in 60% of the new unit's initial year capacity.
Inference: Machined assemblies carry twice the revenue per ton of raw forgings, leading to margin expansion.
Conclusion: Operating profit growth has high asymmetric upside with low down-side execution risk.

health_check.latest_quarter_review: Q1 revenue grew 27% with stable input costs; capex remains on schedule.
